title: sdk: unify auth retries and streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go
author: Ava Kim
description:
Motivation: multiple SDKs had divergent behavior around auth retries, streaming backpressure, and small API ergonomics (chat/stream helpers). This PR harmonizes behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs so application code can rely on consistent retry semantics, backpressure controls, and naming parity.

Summary of changes: unified auth retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter, pluggable max attempts), streaming helper APIs for consistent chunking and error propagation, ergonomics improvements (rename `stream` -> `stream_chat`, align `Client` constructors), and a handful of parity fixes discovered during cross-language dogfooding. Includes version bumps for SDK packages and CI matrix fixes.

Checklist:
- [x] Define shared retry policy and docs
- [x] Implement retry plumbing in python/ts/go SDKs
- [x] Add streaming helper wrappers that surface pause/resume/backpressure hooks
- [x] Add unit + integration tests for retries and streaming
- [x] Update CHANGELOGs and bump package versions

Compatibility/migration notes: callers that used the older `stream` helper should switch to `stream_chat` (alias kept for one release with a deprecation warning). Default retry attempts increased from 2 -> 3; customers using custom retry settings are unaffected. See release_notes for short notes.

Related links: RFC (internal) https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2438/sdk-retries-streaming-rfc, incident notes SUP-1123 (auth flakiness), examples updated in redwood-examples/chat-streaming.

Testing: CI matrix covers python 3.9-3.11, node 18/20, go 1.20. Added deterministic tests for retry jitter using time mocking and streaming end-to-end tests against the local test runtime. CI flaky suite rerun was required for a transient golang race which was fixed in a follow-up commit.

Release notes: - SDK: unified auth retry policy (default 3 attempts) - SDK: streaming ergonomic helpers across Python/TS/Go (`stream_chat`) - Python SDK: client constructor now accepts `auth_retry_policy` named arg - Typescript SDK: improved streaming backpressure controls - Go SDK: parity fixes for streaming Close semantics

Ava Kim (author): Yes — added auth_retry_policy to constructors in python/ts/go so teams can override on a per-client basis. Kept sensible defaults in a single place.
Riley Chen (reviewer): Typescript streaming helper emits 'end' and 'error' events; add a pause/resume API for high-throughput consumers.
Ava Kim (author): Added pause/resume and updated tests; documented backpressure semantics in docs/sdk/streaming.md.
Samira Patel (reviewer): Go streaming Close semantics previously leaked goroutines in race; can you add a stress test?
Ava Kim (author): Added stress test and fixed Close ordering by draining internal channels before returning; CI stress run green.
Riley Chen (reviewer): Approving after CI green and CHANGELOG updates
Jonas Becker (reviewer): LGTM, minor nit about function name in python client which you resolved
